subject: Algorithm
source_sentence: The state-factored Dijkstra algorithm is used for the beam search result.
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: ResNet
source_sentence: We use ResNet-152 pretrained on the ImageNet to extract the 2048-dimensional image feature.
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: supervised
object: mixture of imitation and reinforcement learning
source_sentence: The agent model is first trained with supervised learning via the mixture of imitation and reinforcement learning.
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: Back Translation
source_sentence: The model is then fine-tuned by back translation with environmental dropout.
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: Word Embedding
source_sentence: The word embedding is trained from scratch with size 256 and the dimension of the action embedding is 64.
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: LSTM
source_sentence: The size of the LSTM units is set to 512 (256 for the bidirectional LSTM).
title: 1Our code, data, and models publicly available at: https://github.com/airsplay/R2R-EnvDrop

subject: RMSProp
source_sentence: For optimizing the loss, we use RMSprop (as suggested in Mnih et al. (2016)) with a fixed learning rate 1e-4 and the batch size is 64.
